title: PXR-mediated organophorous flame retardant tricresyl phosphate effects on lipid homeostasis.
one_liner_zh: 该文研究阻燃剂TCP通过核受体PXR影响脂质代谢，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: An emerging experimental framework suggests that endocrine-disrupting compounds are candidate obesogens. However, this potential effect has not yet been determined for Tricresyl phosphate (TCP), a mass-produced organophosphate flame retardant (OPFR) that has been exposed to human beings in many ways. Many OPFRs, including TCP, have been shown to activate pregnane X receptor (PXR), a nuclear receptor that regulates lipid metabolism. Accordingly, we found that TCP exposure caused lipid accumulation in HepG2 cells in this study. Therefore, to elucidate the role of PXR played in TCP metabolism and promotion of lipid accumulation, HepG2 cells were exposed to different concentrations (5 x 10(-8) to 5 x 10(-5) M) of TCP for 24 h. The enlarged hepatic lipid droplets and increased hepatic triglyceride contents were observed in HepG2 cells after TCP exposure for 24 h. This is the result of a confluence of lipogenesis increase and beta-oxidation suppression imposed by PXR activation which was verified by the up regulation of genes in fatty acid (FA) synthesis and the down regulation of genes in beta-oxidation. Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) analysis and molecular docking revealed favorable binding mode of TCP to PXR and the knockout of PXR gene with CRISPR/cpf1 system in HepG2 cells abolished TCP-induced triglyceride accumulation, thus underlying the crucial role of PXR in hepatic lipid metabolism resulting from OPFRs exposure. This study enhances our understanding of molecular mechanisms and associations of PXR in lipid metabolism disturbance induced by TCP and provides novel evidence regarding the lipotoxicity effect and potential metabolism pathway of OPFRs.
abstract_zh: 一个新兴的实验框架表明，内分泌干扰化合物是潜在的致肥胖因子。然而，对于三甲苯基磷酸酯（TCP），一种大量生产且已通过多种途径暴露于人类的有机磷酸酯阻燃剂（OPFR），这种潜在效应尚未被确定。许多OPFRs，包括TCP，已被证明能激活孕烷X受体（PXR），这是一种调节脂质代谢的核受体。据此，本研究发现TCP暴露导致HepG2细胞中脂质积累。因此，为了阐明PXR在TCP代谢及促进脂质积累中的作用，将HepG2细胞暴露于不同浓度（5 x 10(-8) 至 5 x 10(-5) M）的TCP中24小时。TCP暴露24小时后，观察到HepG2细胞中肝脂滴增大和肝甘油三酯含量增加。这是由PXR激活引起的脂肪生成增加和β-氧化抑制共同作用的结果，这通过脂肪酸（FA）合成基因的上调和β-氧化基因的下调得到验证。表面等离子体共振（SPR）分析和分子对接揭示了TCP与PXR的有利结合模式，而使用CRISPR/cpf1系统在HepG2细胞中敲除PXR基因则消除了TCP诱导的甘油三酯积累，从而凸显了PXR在OPFRs暴露导致的肝脏脂质代谢中的关键作用。本研究增进了我们对TCP诱导脂质代谢紊乱中PXR的分子机制及关联的理解，并为OPFRs的脂毒性效应及潜在代谢途径提供了新证据。
